title: Yowie Group Reports FY26 Revenue of US$8.76 Million with Net Loss Narrowing to US$0.20 Million
excerpt: Yowie Group Limited (ASX:YOW) has reported full-year revenue of US$8,758,447 for the year ended 30 June 2026, a decline of 27.1% from US$12,009,824 in the prior year, while its net loss after tax narrowed to US$196,981 from US$7,870,000 in FY25, according to its Appendix 4E preliminary final report signed by Chairman Sulieman Ravell on 1 September 2026.
